records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.LoadingScreen.blow_away#1
records.source: The logo holds until two seconds after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.
records.context: The logo holds until two seconds after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.
records.translation: El logotipo se mantiene hasta dos segundos después de que la cubierta se pintó por primera vez (de inmediato si se llama más tarde), y luego se dispersa durante cuatro segundos: el contenedor negro se desvanece del primer al tercer segundo y la última tesela se ha ido a los cuatro. La cubierta se elimina sola entonces.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.replay_startup_animation#1
records.source: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for two seconds and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
records.context: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for two seconds and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
records.translation: Help > Show startup animation. El contenedor negro con el logotipo vuelve sobre la ventana, se mantiene dos segundos y se dispersa como al inicio. Se reproduce incluso cuando Preferences > Animación > Animación de inicio está desactivada; bajo Accesibilidad > Reducir el movimiento el logotipo se mantiene y luego se funde en un segundo. Un clic o una tecla la omite. El tamaño, el estado y el foco del teclado de la ventana se dejan como estaban.
